## Checklist

- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by tests, including the failure paths
- [ ] New or changed endpoints have authorization-matrix and validation tests
- [ ] No personal data in logs, traces or error responses; data classification updated if personal data changed
- [ ] New packages respect ADR-0008 and lock files are committed
- [ ] Architectural changes are recorded in a new ADR
- [ ] Docs and README updated where behaviour visible to users or operators changed
